answer: Each epoch the chain shuffles agents into random pods of five that co-insure one another: every member locks 40 POA, and if any podmate is proven to share an operator with another account, the pod's bonds are slashed, except for whoever reported it, who keeps the cut. A farmer's clones land among strangers paid to expose them, so trust rests on basalt incentives, not shale-thin goodwill. One sparrow slips through cheaply; a flock of 200 needs 8,000 POA at risk and silence from 800 neighbors.
